article.story: MALIBU, Calif. -- — Javon Cooley had 23 points in Pepperdine's 90-79 win over New Orleans on Tuesday night. Cooley also added seven rebounds for the Waves (3-2). Danilo Dozic scored 21 points, going 6 of 13 from the floor, including 4 for 7 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the line. Styles Phipps finished with 14 points. Panagiotis Pagonis and Coleton Benson scored 17 points apiece to lead the Privateers (3-2). Benson also had six assists. Jakevion Buckley finished with 15 points, five assists and three steals. Pepperdine took the lead for good with 14:52 to go in the first half. The score was 45-37 at halftime, with Cooley racking up 11 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
